verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs state that FirebaseUI, a first-party Firebase component, is open source. The firebase-tools CLI is hosted in a public GitHub repo, but its license is not shown in the evidence. Nothing indicates that the core Firebase backend services (Firestore, Auth, Functions) have readable source under an open license, so openness covers only peripheral client-side pieces. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core product and services, named license terms (e.g. Apache/MIT), license details for the CLI and SDK repos, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: FirebaseUI can be easily customized to fit in with the rest of your app's visual style, and it is open source
